Record Class GameDTO

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.adsl.shared.model.GameDTO
Record Components:
id - unique game identifier
numPlayer - total number of players in this game
round - current round number (1–10)
era - current era (1–3)
players - snapshot of all players' resources and cards
board - snapshot of the board (rows, offer track, order tile)
phase - current game phase
currentPlayerTotem - totem of the player whose turn it is, or null
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record GameDTO(int id, int numPlayer, int round, int era, Set<PlayerDTO> players, BoardDTO board, Phase phase, Totem currentPlayerTotem) extends Record implements Serializable
Immutable full snapshot of a game session sent to all clients after every state change. The client renders the entire UI from this record.
